provenance: Static world_manifest/world model bins plus v0.5 Mesa diagnostic logs. Values are source/render-load estimates, not Xiaomi profiling results.

largest_meshes.name: Земля
largest_meshes.max_draw_range_test: passes by oversized AABB radius; exact near-camera terrain vertex is 40.294m and yaw270 ray hit is 45.002m

texture_memory.assessment: The tested steady viewpoints stay under the 64 MiB cache limit, so logs do not support sustained same-view texture eviction/decode thrash. Yaw90 is close to the cap; movement between texture sets can evict and later reload old textures. Entire Android texture set would decode to about 133 MiB if all were resident.

performance_assessment: Active source geometry is modest for a static room (128,495 triangle instances; 33,269 have renderer centers within 160 m of the spawn). The largest 73,728-triangle mesh is outside the draw-distance test at the spawn.

The oversized outdoor terrain and four NothernLightPlane bounds pass the current center-distance-plus-radius gate despite centers hundreds of metres away. Collectively those candidates contribute 10,098 triangles before frustum rejection; terrain itself is only 1,906 triangles, so this is more a visibility/overdraw candidate than raw geometry-volume explanation.

A 10 FPS report cannot be attributed to triangle volume or steady texture thrash from these source facts alone. Root profiling should include CPU allocation/sorting, GL draw calls, shader time, fill/overdraw and texture upload/eviction counters on the Xiaomi device.
